_comment: Thin-history competition gate: block league/competition tags with too little PRIOR history (strictly before slate date). Not a World-Cup allowlist — Olympics / WBC / Nations League get caught the same way. Pass if prior_days>=min_prior_days OR prior_props>=min_prior_props. Props bar is high so a short mega-tournament (e.g. 2 WC days, ~1.6k props) stays thin until it has real calendar depth.
